entries.label: Morning brief
entries.text:
Today's session — Walk 15 minutes at a comfortable pace:

Today’s plan is a 15-minute walk at a comfortable pace — that’s your one simple anchor to get moving. Just step out, breathe, and let your body settle into the rhythm. You don’t need to do anything more than that; showing up for this is enough. So lace up and give yourself those 15 minutes — they’re yours.
